```{r setup-prov}
DATOS <- params$datos
source("R/tema.R")
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2)
  library(scales); library(forcats); library(patchwork); library(knitr); library(stringr)
})

guardar_prov <- function(p, nombre, alto, ancho = 200) {
  dir.create("figuras_srna", showWarnings = FALSE)
  for (ext in c("png", "pdf"))
    ggsave(file.path("figuras_srna", paste0(nombre, ".", ext)), p,
           width = ancho, height = alto, units = "mm", dpi = 300)
}
lee <- function(f) read_tsv(file.path(DATOS, f), show_col_types = FALSE)

mu   <- lee("srna_muestras.tsv")
pres <- lee("srna_presencia_virus_largo.tsv")
esp  <- lee("srna_especies.tsv")
sinh <- lee("srna_contigs_sin_hit.tsv")

# Orden de librerias: por la fraccion de piRNA que mide EL PROVEEDOR, no la
# nuestra. Son ventanas distintas (24-30 frente a 24-35), asi que el orden
# deberia parecerse al de S1 pero no tiene por que ser identico.
orden <- mu |> arrange(pct_pirna_24_30) |> pull(lib)
pon <- function(d) mutate(d, lib = factor(lib, levels = orden))
mu <- pon(mu); pres <- pon(pres); esp <- pon(esp); sinh <- pon(sinh)

# Las 4 librerias sin pareja en el transcriptoma (M41, M45, M61, M78) entran
# igual: la taxonomia del proveedor no depende del emparejamiento.
extras <- mu |> filter(pareada != "si") |> pull(lib) |> as.character()

eje_lib <- list(
  scale_x_discrete(limits = orden),
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 6),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
)
```

Libraries: `r nrow(mu)`. Unpaired (no transcriptome pool): `r paste(extras, collapse = ", ")`.

## P1 · Overview per library

```{r g-prov-panorama, fig.height = 7}
# --- A. lecturas: crudas, y de esas las que llegan a 18-35 nt
lec <- mu |>
  transmute(lib, Raw = reads_crudas, `18–35 nt` = reads_18_35) |>
  pivot_longer(-lib, names_to = "etapa", values_to = "n") |>
  mutate(etapa = factor(etapa, levels = c("Raw", "18–35 nt")))

pA <- ggplot(lec, aes(lib, n / 1e6, fill = etapa)) +
  geom_col(position = "identity", width = 0.78,
           colour = SUPERFICIE, linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Raw = GRIS, `18–35 nt` = PAL[["azul"]])) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(c(0, 0.05))) +
  eje_lib +
  labs(subtitle = "A · Reads", x = NULL, y = "million reads", fill = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, override.aes = list(colour = NA)))

# --- B. composicion siRNA / piRNA SEGUN EL PROVEEDOR.
# Es una medida independiente de la de S1, calculada sobre otras ventanas
# (20-23 y 24-30 frente a 18-23 y 24-35) y por otro pipeline.
TR <- c("20–23 nt (siRNA)", "24–30 nt (piRNA)", "other")
comp <- mu |>
  transmute(lib,
            `20–23 nt (siRNA)` = pct_sirna_20_23 / 100,
            `24–30 nt (piRNA)` = pct_pirna_24_30 / 100,
            other = 1 - (pct_sirna_20_23 + pct_pirna_24_30) / 100) |>
  pivot_longer(-lib, names_to = "tramo", values_to = "frac") |>
  mutate(tramo = factor(tramo, levels = TR))

pB <- ggplot(comp, aes(lib, frac, fill = tramo)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.78, colour = SUPERFICIE, linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(c(PAL[["azul"]], PAL[["naranja"]], GRIS), TR)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent(), expand = expansion(c(0, 0.02))) +
  eje_lib +
  labs(subtitle = "B · Size composition",
       x = NULL, y = "of the 18–35 nt reads", fill = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, override.aes = list(colour = NA)))

# --- C. contigs ensamblados y como se reparten
CT <- c("Viral (hit)", "No hit", "Non-viral")
ctg <- mu |>
  transmute(lib, `Viral (hit)` = contigs_virales, `No hit` = contigs_sin_hit,
            `Non-viral` = contigs_no_virales) |>
  pivot_longer(-lib, names_to = "clase", values_to = "n") |>
  mutate(clase = factor(clase, levels = CT))

pC <- ggplot(ctg, aes(lib, n, fill = clase)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.78, colour = SUPERFICIE, linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(c(PAL[["azul"]], PAL[["violeta"]], GRIS), CT)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(c(0, 0.05))) +
  eje_lib +
  labs(subtitle = "C · Assembled contigs (≥ 200 nt)",
       x = NULL, y = "contigs", fill = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, override.aes = list(colour = NA)))

pP1 <- (pA / pB / pC) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "small RNA libraries, as processed by smallRNA-Metavir",
    subtitle = paste0("The provider's own pipeline: no host filter, bacterial filter, ",
                      "generic mosquito viral reference.\nLibraries ordered by their ",
                      "piRNA fraction."),
    caption = paste0("Host reads are not reported: the pipeline applies no host ",
                     "filter. Contigs are the CAP3 merge of three size ranges; ",
                     "'viral' means a BLASTN or DIAMOND hit."))
guardar_prov(pP1, "P1_proveedor_panorama", alto = 215)
pP1
```

## P2 · The provider's taxonomy

```{r g-prov-taxonomia, fig.height = 8}
# Deteccion por referencia. `presente_70` aplica el MISMO criterio que el
# transcriptoma (>=70 % del genoma cubierto), asi que las dos tecnicas son
# comparables. El filtro propio del proveedor es mas laxo: >=30 % y >=100
# lecturas.
det <- pres |> filter(presente_70 == "si")

n_pools <- det |> count(virus, name = "libs") |> arrange(libs)
det <- det |> mutate(virus = factor(virus, levels = n_pools$virus))
etq  <- n_pools |> mutate(virus = factor(virus, levels = n_pools$virus))

n_lib <- n_distinct(mu$lib)

pP2 <- ggplot(det, aes(lib, virus, fill = pct_cobertura_max)) +
  geom_tile(colour = SUPERFICIE, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = filter(det, frac_replicativo >= 0.5),
             aes(lib, virus), inherit.aes = FALSE,
             shape = 21, size = 0.9, stroke = 0.35,
             colour = SUPERFICIE, fill = SUPERFICIE) +
  geom_text(data = etq, aes(x = Inf, y = virus, label = paste0(libs, "/", n_lib)),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = -0.25, size = 2.5, colour = TINTA_2) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = AZUL_SEQ, limits = c(70, 100),
                       name = "genome covered") +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = orden) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(title = "Viruses detected by the small RNA, on the provider's own reference set",
       subtitle = paste0("Present: ≥ 70 % of the genome covered — the same criterion ",
                         "as the transcriptome.\nA dot marks a replicating profile ",
                         "(≥ half of that virus's references classified 'viral')."),
              x = NULL, y = NULL,
       caption = str_wrap(paste0(
         "Independent of the vOTU catalogue: the provider maps against a ",
         "generic mosquito viral reference set. Two references are flagged ",
         "by the provider as artefacts (≈50 % coverage in every library)."),
         width = 120)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6.5),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 6),
        legend.position = "top", legend.key.height = unit(3, "mm"),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 24, 5, 5))
guardar_prov(pP2, "P2_proveedor_taxonomia",
             alto = max(120, 5.2 * nrow(n_pools) + 55))
pP2
```

```{r tabla-prov-familias}
# Familia y orden salen del ensamblaje, no del mapeo por referencia, asi que
# hay que cruzar por nombre y puede no casar todo. El conteo de abajo dice
# cuanto caso: si es bajo, los dos vocabularios no coinciden y la tabla se
# queda como esta, sin familia.
fam <- esp |>
  distinct(viral_species, family, order) |>
  filter(!is.na(family), family != "NA")

tax <- n_pools |>
  left_join(fam, by = c("virus" = "viral_species")) |>
  arrange(desc(libs))

cat(sum(!is.na(tax$family)), "of", nrow(tax),
    "virus names matched a family from the assembly tables.\n\n")

tax |>
  transmute(Virus = virus, Family = coalesce(family, "—"),
            Order = coalesce(order, "—"),
            `Libraries` = paste0(libs, "/", n_lib)) |>
  kable()
```

## P3 · De novo discovery: contigs with no database hit

```{r g-prov-descubrimiento, fig.height = 5}
ETIQ_ML <- c(viral = "Replicating profile", eve = "EVE profile")
sinh <- sinh |>
  mutate(clase = factor(ETIQ_ML[clase_ml], levels = ETIQ_ML))
COL_ML <- setNames(c(PAL[["azul"]], PAL[["naranja"]]), ETIQ_ML)

pDa <- ggplot(sinh, aes(lib, fill = clase)) +
  geom_bar(width = 0.78, colour = SUPERFICIE, linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = COL_ML, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(c(0, 0.05))) +
  eje_lib +
  labs(subtitle = "A · Contigs with no hit, by library",
       x = NULL, y = "contigs", fill = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, override.aes = list(colour = NA)))

pDb <- ggplot(sinh, aes(long_contig, fill = clase)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, colour = SUPERFICIE, linewidth = 0.15) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = COL_ML, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = label_number(big.mark = ",")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(subtitle = "B · Their lengths",
       x = "contig length (nt, log scale)", y = "contigs", fill = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

pP3 <- (pDa / pDb) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = paste0(nrow(sinh), " assembled contigs with no similarity in any database"),
    subtitle = paste0("Classified by the provider's model from their small RNA ",
                      "profile alone, with no reference.\nThese are the de novo ",
                      "discovery candidates."),
    caption = str_wrap(paste0(
      "A hit means BLASTN or DIAMOND against the provider's databases. ",
      "No hit is not evidence of novelty on its own: short contigs from ",
      "divergent or poorly sampled lineages look the same as artefacts."),
      width = 120))
guardar_prov(pP3, "P3_proveedor_descubrimiento", alto = 150)
pP3
```

```{r tabla-prov-descubrimiento}
sinh |>
  group_by(clase) |>
  summarise(Contigs = n(),
            `Median length` = round(median(long_contig)),
            `Longest` = max(long_contig),
            `≥ 500 nt` = sum(long_contig >= 500),
            `≥ 1 kb` = sum(long_contig >= 1000),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  rename(Profile = clase) |>
  kable()
```
